name: Virtù

categories.label: Cities track VP
categories.hint: VP at your marker position on the Cities track (0-6 VP).

categories.label: Cities track position (for leader bonus)
categories.labelVi: Vị trí đường Thành phố (thưởng dẫn đầu)
categories.hint: Enter your position on the Cities track; furthest player gets +1 VP (all tied get it). Enter 0 for no progress.

categories.label: Patronage track VP
categories.hint: VP at your marker position on the Patronage track (0-3 VP).

categories.label: Patronage track position (for leader bonus)
categories.labelVi: Vị trí đường Bảo trợ (thưởng dẫn đầu)
categories.hint: Enter your Patronage position; furthest player gets +1 VP (all tied get it). Enter 0 for no progress.

categories.label: Prestige on cards/tiles
categories.hint: Sum Prestige Points printed on cards in your Palace and tiles in your Domain (including Cathedrals 1 each and Resources Exhausted ones).

categories.label: Cross symbols (religious influence)
categories.hint: Count Crosses on Palace cards, Domain tiles, Holy Roman Empire alliance (if no enemy Agent), Duomo/Sistine Chapel bonuses. Awards 4/2/(1)/0 by rank; tied players get the next-lower rank's points.

categories.label: Trophies (military prestige)
categories.hint: 2 VP per Trophy; max 1 Trophy per opponent.

categories.label: Alliances without enemy Agent
categories.labelVi: Liên minh không có Agent địch
categories.hint: 1 VP per Alliance (Bonus used or not).

categories.label: Indulgence cards in Palace
categories.hint: -1 VP per Indulgence card still in your Palace.

categories.label: Crowns in Palace and Domain (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Count Crowns on cards and tiles, available or exhausted.

tiebreakers.description: Most Crowns in Palace and Domain
If still tied, players share victory.

endCondition.description: At end of Spring, if all Cities are controlled, someone controls 8+ Cities, or someone reaches the end of the Patronage track: finish with a final Winter, then score.

notes: family: engine-building + area-majority. Track VP: the exact position-to-VP mapping is printed on the Prestige board, so VP is entered directly; positions are also entered only to award the +1 leader bonus. Crosses reward: 3p 4/2/0, 4p 4/2/1/0, 5p 4/2/1/0/0. The 2-player game (The Wars of Italy) has different scoring and is in virtu--2-player.json.

sources.title: Virtù rulebook for 3-5 players (Super Meeple, EN)
sources.section: pp.23-24 End of the Game; Prestige & Victory; Cathedral p.22; Alliances p.22
